title: How Foundational Skills Influence VLM-based Embodied Agents: A Native Perspective

layout.note: Two dashed groups of cards with a radar chart wedged between them: at left three skill cards are stacked down a column and a fourth (Planning) sits at the bottom next to the chart; the left group's top-right edge is cut diagonally around the chart; at right three task cards are stacked in a dashed rectangle. Each card has a rounded title tab overlapping its top-left corner.

lesson: Show a benchmark as task cards that each hold one render with overlays, an instruction and the expected action list, and put a radar chart between the card groups; colour the tab of each group differently so two granularities read apart.
